## 3. T.A. to Regional/Office Council Members.-  
- (i) Purpose: For attending the meetings of the Third Level/Regional Councils.  
rsmi  
- (ii) TA/DA entitlement as admissible to officers in Pay Level 11 as under:-
- (a) Travel entitlement within the country - Economy Class by Air or AC-II Class including Rajdhani /Shatabdi Express, etc.
